title: NAM run request (nam.v1)
description: POST /v1/nam/run. The backend calls it the way it would call an LLM: a short system prompt and the messages.

system.description: The call site's short instruction, e.g. 'Assess need for request #123'.

case_id.description: The case to continue. Left out, a new case is opened.

case_version.description: The case version the caller last saw (case_version in the last response). If the case has changed since, the call is refused with stale_version and changes nothing.

documents.description: Documents of the case this call is about (ids from an upload), recorded with the call in the audit log. Flows read the case's documents from the document store themselves.

answer.description: The answer to an open question from the last response. value '' skips it.

confirm.description: Confirm the case's pending_action from the last response. It runs only for a role allowed to confirm it, and only if the case has not changed since it was proposed.

skip_questions.description: Stop the follow-up questions and go on with what is known.

undo.description: Need capture: take back the answer to this question, and every answer after it, and ask the same question again.

category.description: Need capture: the category the officer picked before stating the need (goods, services or works).
